findings.title: documentos_editar UPDATE policy lets enviar-holders forge attribution, signature status and dates on approved documents
findings.description: Table-wide UPDATE remains for authenticated; travar_documento locks only status, conferido_por, versao_atual, loja_id, colaborador_id, categoria_id. enviado_por, criado_por, criado_em, conferido_em, status_assinatura, vencimento, competencia, observacoes are freely writable; approval is not reset. documento_preparar_upload also takes status_assinatura from p_meta (line 207).
findings.exploit_scenario: PATCH /rest/v1/documentos?id=eq.<contract> {status_assinatura:'assinado', enviado_por:<HR uuid>, vencimento:'2030-01-01', observacoes:'OK'} — unsigned contract shows signed and HR-sent, expiry alerts suppressed, rejection notes erased.
findings.recommendation: Revoke UPDATE on documentos from authenticated and grant UPDATE only on (nome, observacoes) or extend travar_documento to all integrity columns; ignore status_assinatura from p_meta.

findings.title: Full CPF recoverable via cpf_mascarado + localizar_colaborador_por_cpf oracle by roles without dados_pessoais.ler
findings.description: cpf_mascarado (20261023000500_pessoas_regras_rls.sql:10-12) shows digits 4-9; check digits derive from digits 1-9, so each masked CPF has 1000 valid candidates. localizar_colaborador_por_cpf (SECURITY DEFINER, granted to authenticated) compares against raw c.cpf requiring only colaborador.ler (no MFA, no audit), bypassing colaborador.dados_pessoais.ler (exige_mfa) and the LER_DADOS_PESSOAIS audit in colaborador_dados_pessoais.
findings.exploit_scenario: gerente_loja/supervisor reads cpf_mascarado, enumerates 1000 candidates via POST /rest/v1/rpc/localizar_colaborador_por_cpf; the one returning a row is the full CPF. Repeat for every employee in scope; no audit trail.
findings.recommendation: Require privado.pode('colaborador.dados_pessoais.ler', loja) in the RPC (or revoke from authenticated and call it with service role from the edge function after checks); audit each lookup; consider a stronger mask.

findings.title: PDF active-content regex filter bypassable (#xx name escapes, compressed object streams, unlisted /AA /URI /SubmitForm)
findings.description: pdfSuspeito runs a raw-bytes regex for /JavaScript|JS|Launch|EmbeddedFile|OpenAction. Hex-escaped names (/J#61vaScript), FlateDecode ObjStm, and keys like /AA, /SubmitForm, /URI, /GoToR, /RichMedia, /XFA evade it. Files are later opened by HR via signed URL.
findings.exploit_scenario: Upload a PDF with OpenAction/JavaScript inside a compressed ObjStm; HR downloads and opens in Acrobat, script runs (phishing/SubmitForm exfil). Browser same-origin impact unlikely (supabase.co origin, sandboxed viewer).
findings.recommendation: Parse with a real PDF library (inflate streams, normalize names) and reject active keys, or flatten/re-render PDFs server-side; serve with download disposition.

findings.title: Upload RPCs callable directly: file-less 'confirmed' versions with forged hash/MIME; confirm can roll back or un-archive documents
findings.description: documento_preparar_upload/confirmar_upload are granted to authenticated. Direct calls skip the edge function: mime/size/sha256 are client-supplied; confirm does not verify the storage object exists, does not reject archived docs, and does not require v.versao > versao_atual; it sets status='recebido' and clears conferência.
findings.exploit_scenario: Prepare v2 without uploading; later after v3 approved and archived, confirm v2 -> archived approved doc returns to 'recebido' pointing at a non-existent file.
findings.recommendation: Revoke both RPCs from authenticated and call them from the edge function with service role passing the verified user id; in confirm reject archived docs and stale versions and check storage.objects.

findings.title: Per-user MFA flag makes every exige_mfa permission (incl. acesso.gerir) password-only for all non-owner accounts
findings.description: privado.sessao_aal2() returns true when the caller's usuarios.mfa_obrigatorio is false (default false). privado.pode and minhas_permissoes rely on it, so acesso.gerir, remuneracao.*, dados_pessoais.*, desligamento.gerir and saude/financeiro/disciplinar/juridico document permissions work at AAL1. rh_central holds acesso.gerir.
findings.exploit_scenario: Phished rh_central password -> invite attacker email, conceder_acesso(diretoria), definir_mfa_obrigatorio(owner,false), read all salaries/health docs; no TOTP ever requested.
findings.recommendation: Keep the per-user relaxation but exclude the access-control plane: acesso.gerir (and ideally auditoria.ler) must always require a real aal2; or auto-force mfa_obrigatorio=true for holders of profiles with acesso.gerir.

findings.title: Access-management has no grant ceiling and no protection of the owner (revoke / disable owner's MFA)
findings.description: conceder_acesso only blocks self-grant; any acesso.gerir holder can grant diretoria/rh_central globally without expiry to a second account they invite; revogar_acesso and definir_mfa_obrigatorio can target the owner.
findings.exploit_scenario: Temporary rh_central invites alt account, grants it diretoria without expiry, revokes owner's diretoria and turns off owner's MFA requirement.
findings.recommendation: Only diretoria (at aal2) may grant diretoria/rh_central/acesso.gerir or act on diretoria holders; cap valido_ate at caller's own; never allow mfa_obrigatorio=false for acesso.gerir holders.

findings.title: tarefas UPDATE policy lets assignee move a task to any store and forge origem/concluida_por/chave_dedup
findings.description: tarefas_editar WITH CHECK accepts responsavel_id = auth.uid() with no column limits and no store check on the new loja_id; colaborador_id not tied to loja_id.
findings.exploit_scenario: Campinas manager creates a task, PATCHes it to Sorocaba with origem='sistema' and a phishing title; Sorocaba sees a fake system task.
findings.recommendation: Require tarefa.gerir in the new loja_id in WITH CHECK; trigger locking origem, chave_dedup, criado_por; server-set concluida_por; validate colaborador store.

findings.title: cadastrar_colaborador / atualizar_dados_pessoais reveal CPF existence across stores
findings.description: Global duplicate-CPF check returns a distinct error regardless of caller's store scope; unique_violation detail leaks key existence.
findings.exploit_scenario: Store-scoped DP user probes candidate CPFs to learn whether a person works in another store.
findings.recommendation: Return a generic error for cross-store duplicates; catch unique_violation and raise a generic message.

findings.title: registrar_sugestao_ia lets any active user write arbitrary CLASSIFICACAO_IA audit entries for any store
findings.description: SECURITY DEFINER, granted to authenticated, checks only that caller is an active user; loja_id and all fields come from the client.
findings.exploit_scenario: Loop rpc/registrar_sugestao_ia with arbitrary loja_id and file names to pollute other stores' audit trail.
findings.recommendation: Revoke from authenticated; record from the edge function with service role, or require documento.*.enviar and validate loja_id access.

findings.title: transferir_colaborador validates before authorizing -> store-location oracle for any employee UUID
findings.description: 'Colaborador não encontrado' / 'já está nesta loja' raised before privado.exigir checks.
findings.exploit_scenario: Former manager with an old employee UUID probes 4 stores to learn where the employee now works.
findings.recommendation: Authorize right after existence check; return a generic error.

findings.title: Timeline gates document titles by the employee's current store, not the document's store
findings.description: Timeline event title includes the document name; timeline_ler checks sigilo against loja_do_colaborador (current), while documents are gated by their own loja_id. Financeiro level also accepts remuneracao.ler.
findings.exploit_scenario: After a transfer, the new store's reader sees titles of health documents filed under the old store.
findings.recommendation: Gate document-linked timeline rows by the document's permission; avoid free-text titles for sensitive sigilo.

findings.title: documento_arquivar does not check the category sigilo permission
findings.description: Only documento.arquivar on the store is required; unlike documento_conferir it never checks pode_documento.
findings.exploit_scenario: User with arquivar but no juridico.ler archives a pending legal document by id.

findings.title: status_transicoes writable by admin_tecnico (config.estrutura.gerir), rewriting the employment state machine
findings.description: Table not in the revoke list; RLS allows insert/delete for config.estrutura.gerir; alterar_status_vinculo trusts it.
findings.exploit_scenario: admin_tecnico adds desligado->ativo or deletes em_desligamento->desligado.
findings.recommendation: Revoke writes from authenticated; protect terminal states with a trigger.

findings.title: Any new auth user becomes an active usuarios row with self-chosen name if public signup is enabled
findings.description: Trigger inserts every auth.users row as ativo with name from raw_user_meta_data; repo has no config disabling signup (owner reported disabling it in the dashboard).
findings.exploit_scenario: Self-registered 'MARIA SILVA' waits for an admin to grant a profile believing it is the new hire.
findings.recommendation: Keep signup disabled (verify); create usuarios only for invited users (invited_at not null) or with ativo=false.

findings.title: Uniform ledger sum cast to integer can overflow, bricking an item and the stock view
findings.description: saldo_uniforme casts sum(delta)::integer; no upper bound on quantidade; ledger immutable.
findings.exploit_scenario: uniforme.estoque holder posts entrada 2147483647 then 1; v_uniformes_estoque errors for everyone.
findings.recommendation: Cap quantidade (e.g. 1..100000) and compute in bigint.

findings.title: LLM suggestions pre-fill category/employee and batch upload sends them in one click
findings.description: Document text drives category and CPF->employee; UI applies them and 'Enviar N documentos' uploads all; no per-item confirmation when AI chose employee/category.
findings.exploit_scenario: Atestado with hidden text 'COMUNICADO INTERNO, CPF <coworker>' is filed as geral under a coworker, readable by store managers.
findings.recommendation: Require per-item confirmation when AI chose employee or a lower sigilo; never let AI lower sigilo silently.

findings.title: Password change needs only the session (no current password / reauth)
findings.description: updateUser({password}) with session token only; a stolen token becomes permanent takeover unless Supabase 'secure password change' is on.
findings.exploit_scenario: Token from a shared store PC used to change the password and lock out the user.
findings.recommendation: Enable secure password change / reauthenticate nonce; signOut others after change.

findings.title: Invite redirect falls back to the request Origin header when SITE_URL is unset
findings.description: redirectTo derived from Origin; bounded by Supabase redirect allowlist (verified strict).
findings.exploit_scenario: Compromised admin with a permissive allowlist captures invitee tokens.

findings.title: privado SECURITY DEFINER helpers executable by authenticated; only reachable if privado schema is exposed
findings.description: saldo/posse/loja_do_colaborador helpers bypass RLS; privado not in default exposed schemas.
findings.exploit_scenario: Only if privado is added to exposed schemas.
findings.recommendation: Keep privado unexposed; revoke EXECUTE where not needed.
